source.depth_basis: nominal relative to NAVD88; not chart depth

metadata.equipment: Reson 8101 multibeam, POS/MV vessel motion, SVPlus sound velocity, NavCom 2050 CNAV water level correction
metadata.vertical_datum: NAVD88 from original bathymetry process step
metadata.grid_generation: CARIS cleaned soundings; shoal-biased 1 m decimated xyz; Fledermaus AverageGridder interpolated 2 m DEM; ArcInfo grid delivery. No SkipperCast resampling or datum conversion.
metadata.measured_vs_interpolated: Sonar-derived producer-interpolated grid; individual measured versus filled cells cannot be separated.
metadata.horizontal_accuracy: unverified; position metadata discusses about 2 m, but formal horizontal/vertical accuracy fields are swapped and depth dependent
metadata.vertical_accuracy: unverified; formal horizontal field describes 20 cm vertical, with unspecified confidence and depth dependence; no calibrated per-cell error
metadata.metadata_use_constraints: Legacy XML defers terms to CSUMB and sponsor. Current original-producer policy explicitly governs public noncommercial use.
metadata.lineage: Original Cooper Point 2005 survey products, including slope/hillshade/backscatter/habitat from this archive, are one acquisition family. Exact overlap with other mosaics unresolved; independent acquisition count not increased.

valid_depth_diagnostic.method: Diagnostic nearest-neighbor sampling of every reviewed overlapping comparison raster at native 2 m candidate cell centers, clipped to each reviewed bounds. Counts are not exact polygon areas or independent sonar returns. Positive valid depth in any band counts as existing support.

limits: No current substrate ground truth or fish presence inferred from bathymetry.
No MPA, security, or fishing-rule clearance done by this worker.
Small features require multiple native cells and sonar validation; 2 m pixel size is not guaranteed feature accuracy.
NAVD88 depths remain nominal for the 300 ft filter.
No independent acquisition or public mapped-area credit assigned.
